questions.instruction: The tournaments used to determine an overall champion vary by sport. One type is a best-of-seven series, where up to seven games are played to determine a champion. Assume each team has an equal chance of winning each game, independently. What is the probability of a particular team winning each of the first four games in a best-of-seven series?
questions.stem: The tournaments used to determine an overall champion vary by sport. One type is a best-of-seven series, where up to seven games are played to determine a champion. Assume each team has an equal chance of winning each game, independently. What is the probability of a particular team winning each of the first four games in a best-of-seven series?

answer.explanation: For a specified team, four wins require four independent events of probability1/2: (1/2)^4=1/16. The series ends after the fourth win. The wording clarifies the source’s “a team”; the probability that either team sweeps would instead be1/8.

learning_outcomes.title: Dilation and scale factor
learning_outcomes.rule_summary: Image = scale factor × original coordinates (center at the origin). k>1 enlarges, 0<k<1 reduces.
learning_outcomes.rule_ar: إحداثيات الصورة = معامل المقياس × إحداثيات الأصل (المركز نقطة الأصل). k>1 تكبير و0<k<1 تصغير.

learning_outcomes.title: Proportions in similar polygons
learning_outcomes.rule_summary: Similar polygons have equal corresponding angles and proportional corresponding sides.
learning_outcomes.rule_ar: المضلعات المتشابهة زواياها المتناظرة متطابقة وأضلاعها المتناظرة متناسبة.

learning_outcomes.title: Triangle similarity by AA
learning_outcomes.rule_summary: Two pairs of equal angles are enough to prove two triangles similar (AA).
learning_outcomes.rule_ar: يكفي تطابق زاويتين في المثلثين لإثبات التشابه (AA).

learning_outcomes.title: Triangle similarity: AA, SSS and SAS
learning_outcomes.statement: Triangle similarity: AA, SSS and SAS
learning_outcomes.rule_summary: Choose AA, SSS or SAS: SSS needs three equal ratios, SAS needs two equal ratios with the included angle.
learning_outcomes.rule_ar: اختر AA أو SSS أو SAS: SSS ثلاث نسب متساوية، وSAS نسبتان متساويتان مع الزاوية المحصورة.

learning_outcomes.title: Triangle similarity: AA, SSS and SAS
learning_outcomes.statement: Triangle similarity: AA, SSS and SAS
learning_outcomes.rule_summary: Use the similarity to write proportions between corresponding sides, then solve for the unknown.
learning_outcomes.rule_ar: استخدم التشابه لكتابة تناسب بين الأضلاع المتناظرة ثم حل لإيجاد المجهول.

learning_outcomes.title: Proportional parts of triangles
learning_outcomes.rule_summary: A line parallel to one side divides the other two sides proportionally; the converse also holds.
learning_outcomes.rule_ar: المستقيم الموازي لضلع يقسم الضلعين الآخرين بنسب متناسبة، والعكس صحيح.

learning_outcomes.title: Corresponding bisectors, altitudes and medians
learning_outcomes.rule_summary: In similar triangles, corresponding bisectors, altitudes and medians have the same ratio as the sides.
learning_outcomes.rule_ar: في المثلثات المتشابهة تكون نسبة المنصفات والارتفاعات والمتوسطات المتناظرة مثل نسبة الأضلاع.

learning_outcomes.title: Geometric mean
learning_outcomes.rule_summary: Geometric mean of a and b is √(ab). Altitude to the hypotenuse: h² = (segment 1)(segment 2).
learning_outcomes.rule_ar: الوسط الهندسي للعددين a وb هو √(ab). الارتفاع على الوتر: h² = حاصل ضرب القطعتين.

learning_outcomes.title: Pythagorean Theorem
learning_outcomes.rule_summary: In a right triangle a²+b²=c², where c is the hypotenuse.
learning_outcomes.rule_ar: في المثلث القائم a²+b²=c² حيث c الوتر.

learning_outcomes.title: Applications of the Pythagorean Theorem
learning_outcomes.rule_summary: Draw the right triangle hidden in the situation, label legs and hypotenuse, then apply a²+b²=c².
learning_outcomes.rule_ar: ارسم المثلث القائم في المسألة وحدد الضلعين والوتر ثم طبّق a²+b²=c².

learning_outcomes.title: Distance between points
learning_outcomes.rule_summary: d = √((x₂−x₁)²+(y₂−y₁)²).
learning_outcomes.rule_ar: المسافة d = √((x₂−x₁)²+(y₂−y₁)²).

learning_outcomes.title: 45°–45°–90° triangles
learning_outcomes.rule_summary: Sides are in ratio 1 : 1 : √2. Hypotenuse = leg × √2.
learning_outcomes.rule_ar: النسبة بين الأضلاع 1 : 1 : √2. الوتر = الضلع × √2.

learning_outcomes.title: 30°–60°–90° triangles
learning_outcomes.rule_summary: Sides are in ratio 1 : √3 : 2 (short leg, long leg, hypotenuse).
learning_outcomes.rule_ar: النسبة بين الأضلاع 1 : √3 : 2 (الضلع القصير، الطويل، الوتر).

learning_outcomes.title: Trigonometric ratios: sides and angles
learning_outcomes.rule_summary: sin = opposite/hypotenuse, cos = adjacent/hypotenuse, tan = opposite/adjacent. Use the inverse key to find an angle.
learning_outcomes.rule_ar: sin = المقابل/الوتر، cos = المجاور/الوتر، tan = المقابل/المجاور. استخدم المعكوس لإيجاد الزاوية.

learning_outcomes.title: Trigonometric applications
learning_outcomes.rule_summary: Sketch the right triangle, choose the ratio that links the known and unknown sides, solve.
learning_outcomes.rule_ar: ارسم المثلث القائم واختر النسبة التي تربط المعلوم بالمجهول ثم حل.

learning_outcomes.title: Represent sample spaces
learning_outcomes.rule_summary: List all outcomes with a table, tree diagram or organised list.
learning_outcomes.rule_ar: اكتب جميع النواتج بجدول أو شجرة أو قائمة منظمة.

learning_outcomes.title: Fundamental Counting Principle
learning_outcomes.rule_summary: If choices are made in stages, multiply the number of options at each stage.
learning_outcomes.rule_ar: عند الاختيار على مراحل اضرب عدد الخيارات في كل مرحلة.

learning_outcomes.title: Dependent and independent events
learning_outcomes.rule_summary: Independent: P(A and B)=P(A)·P(B). Dependent: P(A and B)=P(A)·P(B given A).
learning_outcomes.rule_ar: مستقلة: P(A∩B)=P(A)·P(B). معتمدة: P(A∩B)=P(A)·P(B|A).

learning_outcomes.title: Conditional probability
learning_outcomes.rule_summary: P(B | A) = P(A and B) / P(A).
learning_outcomes.rule_ar: P(B|A) = P(A∩B) / P(A).

learning_outcomes.title: Mutually and non-mutually exclusive events
learning_outcomes.rule_summary: Mutually exclusive: P(A or B)=P(A)+P(B). Otherwise subtract the overlap: P(A)+P(B)−P(A and B).
learning_outcomes.rule_ar: متنافية: P(A∪B)=P(A)+P(B). غير ذلك اطرح التقاطع: P(A)+P(B)−P(A∩B).

learning_outcomes.title: Properties of similar polygons
learning_outcomes.rule_summary: Scale factor = ratio of corresponding sides; perimeters have the same ratio, areas the square of it.
learning_outcomes.rule_ar: معامل المقياس = نسبة الأضلاع المتناظرة؛ المحيطات بالنسبة نفسها والمساحات بمربعها.

learning_outcomes.title: Proportional parts of triangles
learning_outcomes.rule_summary: Write the proportion of the divided sides and compare ratios to test parallelism.
learning_outcomes.rule_ar: اكتب تناسب الأجزاء وقارن النسب لاختبار التوازي.

learning_outcomes.title: Trigonometric ratios: perimeter and area
learning_outcomes.rule_summary: Find missing sides with sin/cos/tan, then use P = sum of sides and A = ½·b·h.
learning_outcomes.rule_ar: أوجد الأضلاع المجهولة بالنسب المثلثية ثم استخدم المحيط = مجموع الأضلاع والمساحة = ½·ق·ع.

learning_outcomes.title: Angles of elevation and depression
learning_outcomes.rule_summary: Angles of elevation/depression are measured from the horizontal; draw the right triangle and use tan.
learning_outcomes.rule_ar: تقاس زاويتا الارتفاع والانخفاض من الأفقي؛ ارسم المثلث القائم واستخدم tan.

learning_outcomes.title: Dependent and independent probabilities
learning_outcomes.rule_summary: Check whether the first draw changes the second: with replacement events are independent.
learning_outcomes.rule_ar: تحقق هل يؤثر السحب الأول في الثاني: مع الإرجاع تكون الحوادث مستقلة.

learning_outcomes.title: Mutually and non-mutually exclusive probabilities
learning_outcomes.rule_summary: P(A or B)=P(A)+P(B)−P(A and B); the overlap is 0 only for mutually exclusive events.
learning_outcomes.rule_ar: P(A∪B)=P(A)+P(B)−P(A∩B)؛ يكون التقاطع صفراً فقط للحوادث المتنافية.
